title: Loker Run Manifest
description: Append-only artefact registry persisted at runs/<id>/manifest.json (PRD FR-23b). Each entry is content-addressed by sha256 so the resume path can detect tampering or partial writes. Entries are added phase-by-phase; an empty entries array is legal between run start and the first phase artefact landing.

workflow_name.description: Optional name of the workflow definition used to produce this run. Set by RunDir::create() for runs created from a workflow spec; absent in legacy runs or runs started directly from a spec path.

schema_version.description: Schema version of the manifest envelope. Intentionally un-namespaced: the same key is used across all loker artefacts and across HITL files (whose canonical shape uses bare 'schema_version'). All other loker-specific keys keep the 'loker.' prefix.

name.description: Path of the artefact relative to the run directory (e.g., design/design.md, verify/01.json).

schema_version.description: Schema version of the artefact this entry references.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex sha256 of the artefact bytes at the moment of the manifest write. For directory kinds (e.g., 'changes/'), the producer hashes a deterministic manifest of the directory contents (sorted relative paths joined with their per-file sha256s, newline-separated) rather than a single file. Producers MUST document the exact serialization they used so verifiers can reproduce the digest.
